items.rationale: The fixed unit suffered lightning-overvoltage damage under §§2.3.3 and 4.2.3 and sits outside the five-metre exclusion in §2.3.10(c). The estimate covers like-for-like equipment only under §7.1.9(a), with no deductible amount supplied.

The unit is within five metres of the hob, so §2.3.10(c) excludes its surge damage without a kitchen climate endorsement. The positive figure is a conditional equipment estimate, not a payable amount.

Section 7.1.9(c) expressly covers ordinary removal, fitting, connection and commissioning labour for this covered replacement. The estimate is for labour only, excluding the separately billed console and freight.
Under §7.1.11, installation follows the principal item, which §2.3.10(c) excludes. The positive figure is a conditional labour estimate only.

Section 7.1.9(b) covers the equivalent support needed to mount the insured replacement because the scorched original could not be reused. The estimate allows for a standard console, not a decorative upgrade.

Sections 7.1.9(e), 7.1.11 and 7.1.12 cover only the living-room unit's share of ordinary freight. Using relative equipment values absent a weight-based charge breakdown, about 61% of estimated €100 freight is payable.
